user_question: Create a choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts. Active commitments: analytical_spatial_unit=Centre County census tracts

workflow_plan.goal: Create a choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Clip hospitals to Centre County coverage
workflow_steps.purpose: Restrict hospital points to the Centre County coverage represented by the supplied county subdivisions before spatial aggregation.
workflow_steps.instructions: Clip the hospital point layer using the county-subdivision polygon layer as the spatial mask. Preserve hospital attributes and output a GeoPackage vector layer.

workflow_steps.title: Aggregate hospital beds by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute total hospital beds for each Centre County census tract using point-in-polygon spatial aggregation.
workflow_steps.instructions: Sum the observed BEDS attribute from the clipped hospital points within each census tract. Write the result to the output field total_hospital_beds and retain tract attributes and geometry in a GeoPackage layer.

workflow_steps.title: Map total hospital beds
workflow_steps.purpose: Generate the requested choropleth map of total hospital beds by census tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Generate an interactive HTML choropleth from the hospital_beds_by_tract layer using the total_hospital_beds attribute. Include the tract geometries and source verification metadata.

requirements.scope: The hospital point layer and county-subdivision mask used by t_clip_hospitals_to_centre_county must have compatible CRSs for clipping.

The clipped hospital points and census tract polygons used by t_sum_hospital_beds_by_tract must have valid, non-empty geometries.
The hospital input to t_sum_hospital_beds_by_tract must contain the numeric BEDS field required for summation.
